about: T4 E2 (NUMBER PENDING, train e95): `request.earnings` / `request.dividends` / `request.splits` on the chart's own symbol, rewritten at parse into an event read (`pine.js::eventAsSecurity`), supplied by the events door only (`eventSupply.js`, never `/api/bars`), placed as TradingView places them (`pineEvents.js::placeEvents`, E0's R1 and R2), withheld by name before UCT's record and before the earnings window, and `na` on every bar for a fund. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: a script's own string spelling the engine's internal event name is no longer recognised early (it falls to the punctuation rule)
mutants.from: if (EVENT_TICKER.test(t)) return { code: OTHER_SYMBOL_REFUSAL.EVENT_SPELLING, reason: eventSpellingReason(t) }
mutants.to: if (false) return { code: OTHER_SYMBOL_REFUSAL.EVENT_SPELLING, reason: eventSpellingReason(t) }

mutants.mutant: a raw symbol string carrying the internal event name is no longer recognised
mutants.from: if (EVENT_TICKER.test(tail)) return { ticker: tail, code: OTHER_SYMBOL_REFUSAL.EVENT_SPELLING, reason: eventSpellingReason(tail) }
mutants.to: if (false) return { ticker: tail, code: OTHER_SYMBOL_REFUSAL.EVENT_SPELLING, reason: eventSpellingReason(tail) }
